summary: Specifies an RTP payload header format for carrying video streams produced under the 1998 version of ITU-T Recommendation H.263. It lets this video be sent in real time over IP networks. It was a proposed standard, replaced by RFC 4629.

eli5.summary: Video is chopped into small pieces to travel over the internet. This says exactly how to label and pack the pieces of one video format so the receiver can put them back together.

questions: how is h.263 video sent over rtp
what is the h.263+ rtp payload format
